If this explanation shall not cause the critic to throw the work aside, we would welcome him to whatever pleasure he may find in its perusal.

25309-child-s-story-of-the-bible.title: Story of the Bible
25309-child-s-story-of-the-bible.creator: Dewolfe, Fiske & Co.
25309-child-s-story-of-the-bible.description: A book by Dewolfe, Fiske & Co.. When the children gather at mother's knee, and the tiniest finds a place in mother's arms, and all clamor for a "story," "a story, mamma," how lovely is the picture--the living picture--that circle makes! Love, longing, wisdom, expectancy, faith, shining eyes, lips that move involuntarily, keeping time to the sweet movements of mother's lips!

39630-recollections-of-abraham-lincoln-1.description: A book by Ward Hill Lamon. 41852-court-beauties-of-old-whitehall-hi.title: Historiettes Of The Restoration
41852-court-beauties-of-old-whitehall-hi.creator: W. R. H. Trowbridge
41852-court-beauties-of-old-whitehall-hi.description: A book by W. R. H. Trowbridge. It was the dream of Richelieu, as everybody knows, to make the French monarchy independent and absolute. This dream was only half realised when the Cardinal died, but as he was too astute not to foresee that after his death there would be a violent reaction against his policy, he had sought a successor who would be capable of finishing what he was obliged to leave undone.

arxiv-2012-14030.title: Residual Mean Field Model of Valence Quarks in the Nucleon
arxiv-2012-14030.creator: Christopher Leon and Misak Sargsian
arxiv-2012-14030.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Christopher Leon and Misak Sargsian. We develop a non-perturbative model for valence parton distribution functions (PDFs) based on the mean field interactions of valence quarks in the nucleonic interior. The main motivation for the model is to obtain a mean field description of the valence quarks as a baseline to study the short range quark-quark interactions that generate the high x x tail of PDFs. The model is based on the separation of the valence three-quark cluster and residual system in the nucleon.

arxiv-2305-14859.title: Utility-Probability Duality of Neural Networks
arxiv-2305-14859.creator: Huang Bojun, Fei Yuan
arxiv-2305-14859.description: Abstract It is typically thought that supervised training of modern neural networks is a process of fitting the groudtruth probabilities. However, many counter-intuitive observations in language generation tasks let one wonder if this canonical probabilistic explanation can really account for the observed empirical success.

arxiv-2403-16171.title: q q -Deformed glueballs spectrum in AdS/QCD correspondence
arxiv-2403-16171.creator: Fabiano F. Santos 1 and F. A. Brito 2,3
arxiv-2403-16171.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fabiano F. Santos 1 and F. A. Brito 2,3. This work presents the application of the q q -algebra in the glueballs spectrum. This algebra is implemented through Jackson derivatives in a Schrödinger-like equation resulting from the gravity fluctuations around the braneworld scenario in five dimensions. In our prescription, we consider a four-dimensional AdS 4 brane, living in AdS 5 bulk, that is also known for describing locally localized gravity via quasi-zero mode.

arxiv-2504-05317.title: On Synthesizing Data for Context Attribution in Question Answering
arxiv-2504-05317.creator: Gorjan Radevski, Kiril Gashteovski, Shahbaz Syed, Christopher Malon, Sebastien Nicolas, Chia-Chien Hung, Timo Sztyler, Verena Heußer, Wiem Ben Rim, Masafumi Enomoto, Kunihiro Takeoka, Masafumi Oyamada, Goran Glavaš, Carolin Lawrence
arxiv-2504-05317.description: Abstract Question Answering (QA) accounts for a significant portion of LLM usage “in the wild”. However, LLMs sometimes produce false or misleading responses, also known as hallucinations . Therefore, grounding the generated answers in contextually provided information—i.e., providing evidence for the generated text—is paramount for LLMs’ trustworthiness. Providing this information is the task of context attribution .

arxiv-2506-21726.title: Scalable Dip-Coated Bragg Mirrors for Strong Light–Matter Coupling with 2D Perovskites
arxiv-2506-21726.description: Abstract We report a scalable and cost-effective method for fabricating high-performance Bragg mirrors using a bottom-up approach that combines evaporation-induced self-assembly (EISA) and dip-coating. The photonic crystals are composed of alternating mesoporous SiO 2 and dense TiO 2 layers, providing a high refractive index contrast ( ∼ \sim 0.8).

arxiv-2509-10354.title: Bayesian Semiparametric Joint Modeling of Gap-Time Distribution for Multitype Recurrent Events and a Terminal Event
arxiv-2509-10354.creator: Mithun Kumar Acharjee, AKM Fazlur Rahman
arxiv-2509-10354.description: Abstract In biomedical settings, multitype recurrent events such as stroke and heart failure occur frequently, often concluding with a terminal event such as death. Understanding the links between these recurring and terminal events is fundamental to developing interventions that delay detrimental outcomes. Joint modeling is needed to quantify the dependence between event types and between recurrent events and mortality.

Neuronal death, neuroinflammation, and breakdown of the blood brain barrier (BBB) constitute vicious circles of JE progression. Currently, there is no effective therapy to prevent this damage.

pmc-11513890.description: Interleukin-1 receptor associated kinase 4 (IRAK4) is an essential mediator of the IL-1R and TLR signaling pathways, both of which have been implicated in multiple autoimmune conditions. Hence, blocking the activity of IRAK4 represents an attractive approach for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.

pmc-11626208.title: IRGM Deficiency Exacerbates Sepsis-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Inhibiting Autophagy Through the AKT/mTOR Signaling Pathway
pmc-11626208.creator: Na Guo, Yu Xia, Nannan He, Huixin Cheng, Lei Zhang, Jian Liu
pmc-11626208.description: BackgroundSepsis is a life-threatening condition characterized by organ dysfunction due to an impaired immune response to infection. The lungs are highly susceptible to infection, often resulting in acute lung injury (ALI). The immune-related GTPase M (IRGM) and its murine homolog Irgm1 mediate autophagy and are implicated in inflammatory diseases, yet their roles in sepsis-induced ALI remain unclear.

pmc-12422582.description: Colonisation of mosquitos by the malarial parasite is critically reliant on the invasive ookinete stage. Ookinete invasion of mosquito is coordinated by the apical complex, a specialised parasite structure containing components for secretion, attachment and penetration. While studies have investigated cytoskeletal and secretory elements, it is currently unknown if signalling modules are present or functional at the apical complex.

pmc-12523021.title: European perspectives on pre-hospital interagency collaboration during terrorist incidents: a focus group study
pmc-12523021.creator: Dana Raub, Michael Bentele, Yohan Robinson
pmc-12523021.description: BackgroundRecent international developments have led to increased terrorist activity and intentional violence across Europe. Interagency collaboration has repeatedly been identified as a key challenge in previous scenarios. This study explores the perspectives of European pre-hospital medical providers and law enforcement officers on collaboration during violent incidents, aiming to identify barriers, best practices, and opportunities for improvement.
